rows.notes: ACC's own page: pilot line, production started end 2021, qualification/testing hub for ACC gigafactories (not commercial scale). v1 nameplate 0.15 GWh/yr came from an incoherent 'per day' annualisation with no source -> nulled; no open source gives a GWh figure, so capacity and installed are null. chemistry/cell_format not stated on the ACC page -> nulled (v1 NMC unconfirmed for this site). announced_year not re-verified -> null. Current (2026) operating status of the pilot line is not stated on any page I could open (the facility page is undated); TotalEnergies lists Nersac as industrial excellence centre per a search snippet only (not opened), so confidence capped 0.45. Pilot site, JV partners unchanged from v1 (TotalEnergies/Saft, Stellantis, Mercedes-Benz).

Operational since 2023 (electrive Feb 2026: 'first and so far only factory ... producing cells since 2023'). installed basis: press (Motor1: first block 'capacité initiale de 13,4 GWh'; v1 had 13). Block 1 ramp is slow (reject rates 15-20%, ~5,000 cars/month in Sept 2026 per Bevolt 2026-09-04, which I opened but do not cite). Block 2 = 12.9 GWh, series production expected 2027 (electrive 2026-10-12: total 'just under 26 GWh'); phases: block1 13.4 built (S07) + block2 12.9 under construction (S06) + block3 ~13 planned -> ~40 GWh (S08). nameplate 40 / ref_year 2030 rests on S08 (three blocks ~40 GWh) and S09 (battery-tech.net trade site: 'by 2030'); Motor1 notes ACC gives no official total for 2027, and electrive/Motor1 do not state a third-block date. ref_year 2030 therefore single weaker source. Kaiserslautern and Termoli are separate and cancelled (see their rows); the 40 GWh here is Douvrin's three blocks, not the 120 GWh three-site plan. cell_format v1 'pouch' unconfirmed -> null. capacity_by_year_json v1 {2023:13,2030:40} not re-sourced year by year -> null.

Cancelled: ACC management told employee representatives in Feb 2026 that the Kaiserslautern and Termoli projects are 'definitively shelved' (electrive 2026-02-09; Italian press 2026-02-09 'ufficializza lo stop'). On hold since May 2024. Status kept 'announced' (no cell-line construction; the Euronews/electrive pages give no GWh). v1 planned nameplate 40 GWh (ref 2030; 13.4 GWh first phase) nulled: no current plan exists and no opened page states the GWh figure; planned figure retained here only as history. v1 chemistry/format were the Douvrin product and planning-stage assumptions -> nulled. Coordinates unchanged (v1 city-level).

Cancelled Feb 2026: UILM union said ACC confirmed the Termoli gigafactory 'has been definitively shelved' (Euronews 2026-02-07); electrive 2026-02-09 and Quotidiano 2026-02-09 confirm. On hold since May 2024; never under construction as cell plant. v1 40 GWh planned nameplate nulled (cancelled; no GWh figure on opened pages) - historic plan ~40 GWh by 2030 only mentioned in v1 notes. Coordinates unchanged (v1, existing Stellantis site).

Cancelled: Blackstone Technology GmbH filed for insolvency June 2023; by Jan 2024 no bidder for the Doebeln site and assets to be sold piecemeal; Wirtschaftswoche (via electrive) says series cell production 'never took place because the process did not work'. So no commercial production was ever reached -> status downgraded from null to announced/cancelled (v1 start_year 2021 and 0.05-0.5 GWh pilot ramp not re-confirmed -> nulled; v1 nameplate 5 GWh was a never-built plan -> null). No 2025-2026 news found (searched English/German); site fate after Jan 2024 unconfirmed, confidence 0.6 reflects that. chemistry (v1 LFP 3D-printed) not on opened pages -> null. is_cell_manufacturer unchanged.

Status unconfirmed beyond 2024: Blue Solutions (17 May 2024 release) says it 'is the only company to manufacture solid-state lithium-metal batteries on an industrial scale' at its Ergue-Gabéric factory; no current GWh/MWh figure is on any page I could open (franceforbatteries.fr returned 503; the 2024 release gives no site capacity). v1 nameplate 1.5 GWh / 0.5 GWh figures came from 2024 trade sources I could not re-open -> nulled; plant is sub-GWh by v1's own account. On 8 Sept 2026 Bollore announced a plan to end Bluebus e-bus production (Bluebus is the main LMP customer; PSE 74 jobs) and a project to change Blue Solutions' next-generation (Gen4) strategy with a 41-job PSE (Boursier.com/Fortuneo); the release does not mention Quimper/Ergue-Gabéric, so project_state stays active but demand for LMP cells is at risk. The 25 GWh Alsace gigafactory (announced May 2024, production from 2030) is a separate, not-built project, not this row - candidate for discovery (see hand-off). start_year 2013, end_market, cell_format not confirmed -> null.

v1 said operational 1 GWh/yr since 2024 - not supported. Porsche (25 Aug 2025) stopped own cell production plans, calling the 1 GWh 'start-up factory' a pilot-scale effort; IG Metall (26 Aug 2025) says the new cell factory was 'nicht mal fertig' with excavators still on site, <3 years after Grundsteinlegung -> status under_construction, never commercial production. On 8 May 2026 Porsche announced closure of Cellforce (about 50 remaining staff; talks with works council to follow; Stuttgarter Zeitung: 'Endgültiges Aus'). Alternative status 'operational' (pilot line existed) rejected: Porsche itself calls it pilot production, not commercial.

Itzehoe is the surviving site: after the April 2025 insolvency a consortium led by Abacon (Salvia reportedly also; electrive 2025-07-03) bought the business in July 2025; dpa-AFX 17 Dec 2025: restructuring complete, CustomCells 'stellt unveraendert in Itzehoe ... Lithium-Ionen-Batteriezellen her' and refocuses on defence and motorsport. Small-series/prototype scale, no GWh figure found (nameplate/installed null). chemistry 'other' = generic Li-ion incl. silicon-anode cells (unspecified). No 2026 news found. Tuebingen site closed - see its row. Coordinates are Itzehoe city centroid (unchanged; shared with Liacon row).

v1 said operational and 'continues' - wrong. Closed: chemie.de 2025-07-07 says the Tuebingen pilot plant had no viable prospects for reopening and was being wound down; dpa-AFX 2025-12-17: 'Der Standort in Tuebingen ist geschlossen worden'. Status kept 'operational' = furthest stage reached (pilot/small-series cell line, v1 notes the 46 mm pilot line added 2025); project_state cancelled (closed, not bought). No GWh figure (v1 had none). Assumption: a closed pilot plant stays in the dataset as operational+cancelled rather than being removed (never-existed test fails). chemistry 'other' generic Li-ion; cell_format not re-confirmed -> null.

Construction started 6 July 2026 (Eni release). Nameplate: ESS News (29 May 2026) quotes 'second gigafactory for cell and module production, with a capacity of over 8 GWh/year, by 2029' (Teverola 2 is the first) -> 8 GWh, ref_year 2029 (v1 had 2030, the hub-level date). The Eni release gives a hub figure of 16 GWh/yr by 2030 across Brindisi + Teverola (S30; Eni says half Brindisi, half Teverola but does not state 8 for Brindisi explicitly) - consistent but ref_year differs 2029 vs 2030; kept 2029 (site-specific). Note '>8' could mean 8.5 (Teverola 2 reported 8.5 elsewhere); 8 used. Capacity covers cells+modules; second phase adds LFP cathode and recycling (not cell capacity). Eni and Seri's FIB each 50% (Eni release; marketing company FAENIX is a separate entity). Cell format not stated -> null. Teverola is a separate row (faam-...). Operator/JV unchanged.

Site = Teverola 1 (operating LFP pouch pilot/series line, 0.3 GWh; v1 said 0.35) + Teverola 2 (8 GWh LFP, under construction). Status changed from under_construction to operational because ESS News (29 May 2026) says the first LFP cell plant at Teverola 'is already operational' and Seri's page calls Teverola 1 a '0.3 GWh pilot center' - furthest stage reached incl. partial production; alternative (keep under_construction, treat T1 as pilot) rejected per D-016 'operational even partial'. installed basis: company (Seri page undated; as_of set to the ESS News date). Nameplate 8 GWh = Seri page for Teverola 2; Il Sole 24 Ore (27 Feb 2026): line brings the Campania site to 8 GWh/yr (so 8 is the site total including T1, not 8.3) with 'Production of Teverola 2 ... by 2027'; ref_year 2027 = that production start (no separate full-capacity date). Some sources say 8.5 GWh (not opened). start_year null: the Teverola 1 start year is not confirmed by an opened page; 2027 is only the Teverola 2 gigafactory production start (S34), kept in capacity_ref_year and this note. Financing ~EUR150m pool April 2026, ~EUR200m spent by end-2025 (Il Sole). Cell format prismatic = Seri description of T2 (T1 is soft pouch); chemistry LFP for both per Seri/ESS News. Brindisi hub (Eni/FIB) is a separate row.
